title: Soldiers searching for land mines find South Korea’s 600 years old gun

The intricate details engraved on it can help historians piece together Korea's journey in firearm technology and military tactics from the times of the Goryeo and early Joseon dynasties.

title: New Jersey wildlife centre cares for 219 box turtles dumped near river
